stage0095_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Vice Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$...
　Might I have a moment of your time?」

stage0095_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「You're from the press, I see.」

stage0095_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$イザベル$$
「My name is $$イザベル・クロンカイト$$.」

stage0095_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「You're the author of 'Does the World Need
　the Dancouga?' and 'The End of Ruin and Rebirth.'」

stage0095_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Thank you for reading my work.
　...I've come today because I have a question.」

stage0095_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Please explain what has been happening
　these past few days within the Earth
　Federation government, starting with $$大統領$$.」

stage0095_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$イザベル$$
「$$大統領$$, Ambassador $$マリナ・イスマイール$$,
　Representative Athha of Orb, Vice Minister $$ナナリー$$,
　moderate lawmakers... and you...」

stage0095_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Now, with a large-scale battle between
　Neo Zeon and the Earth Federation Forces
　about to begin, what exactly is happening?」

stage0095_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$レディ$$
「...I'm sorry.
　I can't say anything more, not yet.」

stage0095_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$イザベル$$
「With the recent sudden abnormal weather
　and the escalating war, citizens' anxiety
　is growing.」

stage0095_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Even more than that, people are unsettled
　by the birth delays being reported worldwide.」

stage0095_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Is all this hurried activity these past few
　days some kind of announcement about these issues?」

stage0095_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「...I'm sorry.
　Please wait just a little longer.」

stage0095_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$イザベル$$
「And when exactly is 'a little longer'?」

stage0095_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$イザベル$$
「That's two days from now.」

stage0095_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「There, $$大統領$$ will personally announce
　to everyone the truth that holds humanity's fate.」

stage0095_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$イザベル$$
「...Is it all right if I make an article of this?」

stage0095_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「It's so as many people as possible can
　hear what we have to say. I already have
　$$大統領$$'s permission.」

stage0095_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Besides, I believe this person will understand what we intend.」

stage0095_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「May I ask this of you?」

stage0095_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$イザベル$$
「Understood. I won't needlessly stir up fear,
　but use the power of the press to convey
　the facts and the situation accurately.」

stage0095_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$リリーナ$$
（$$ヒイロ$$...
　We, and Dr. $$トライア$$ too, will do
　everything we can.）

stage0095_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$リリーナ$$
（And I believe in all of you...
　That you will surely protect the world...
　and the future...）

stage0095_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I've dealt with all of the Federation's
　advance units heading this way.」

stage0095_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シャア$$
「So we managed to strike at least some of
　Chrono's forces...」

stage0095_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Who knows...
　Since we don't know how deep they've dug
　into the Federation, hitting hard is all we can do.」

stage0095_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's what I believe I've been doing all along.」

stage0095_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「It's still not enough.
　That's why we have no choice but to resort to this.」

stage0095_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I'm leaving the defense of $$アクシズ$$
　to you and $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

stage0095_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Standing on the front line yourself?」

stage0095_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ナナイ$$ won't be too pleased about it, though.」

stage0095_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That goes for me too.
　You have a duty to fulfil as Supreme Commander.」

stage0095_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シャア$$
「If anything happens, I'm leaving Neo Zeon to you.」

stage0095_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it.
　I'm only doing what must be done.」

stage0095_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Is that settling things with $$アムロ・レイ$$?」

stage0095_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$シャア$$
「He isn't the only one I have to
　settle things with.」

stage0095_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「And that's how you mean to shake off $$ララァ・スン$$?」

stage0095_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「It's about time you stopped acting on
　personal feelings. You have a role to fulfil
　not as one man, but as one adult.」

stage0095_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Think of $$ギュネイ$$ too, who resists you
　even as he tries to surpass you, and $$クェス$$,
　who believes in you.」

stage0095_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$シャア$$
「For not giving up on someone like me,
　and staying with me all this time.」

stage0095_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$シャア$$
「I have no such luxury.
　I know how tough $c is better than you do.」

stage0095_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シャア$$
「I value your skill.
　If anything happens, I'm counting on you
　with Neo Zeon.」

stage0095_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...What about $$フル・フロンタル$$?」

stage0095_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シャア$$
「I have a plan for that.」

stage0095_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「To hear words like that from you, of all people.」

stage0095_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シャア$$
「...This is a good chance.
　Let me apologize for what happened before...
　the Gwadan incident during the $$多元戦争$$.」

stage0095_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「When you met $$ミネバ$$'s body double?」

stage0095_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　Back then I condemned you for hiding
　$$ミネバ$$'s existence through such a cheap trick...」

stage0095_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シャア$$
「But meeting the real $$ミネバ$$ again,
　I understood that what I said was wrong.」

stage0095_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シャア$$
「She's grown up honest and true.
　Let me thank you for that.」

stage0095_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Why bring that up now...」

stage0095_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シャア$$
「And there's one more thing...
　I'm grateful you respected $$ミネバ$$'s wishes
　and didn't force her back, too.」

stage0095_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's not to my credit.
　...She is who she is.
　If you want to praise her, tell her yourself.」

stage0095_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Don't push yourself too hard, $$シャア$$.
　Don't forget I'm here.」

stage0095_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I refuse to go around cleaning up your messes.」

stage0095_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「So... make sure you come back.」

stage0095_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Pushing myself, is it...
　$$ハマーン$$'s right, I suppose...」

stage0095_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シャア$$
「But that will all be over soon...」

stage0095_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シャア$$
（The rest is up to you, $$アムロ$$, $$ハマーン$$...）

stage0095_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I suppose it's about time Earth makes
　public the truth about the Prison of Time...」

stage0095_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$...
　Both choices given to humanity are far too harsh.」

stage0095_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though if $$アクシズ$$, the Great Singularity,
　falls before that, it won't even be a matter
　of $$時空修復$$ - it'll all be up to Geminis.」

stage0095_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then... I wonder if the people of Earth
　can seize their own future with their own hands...」

stage0095_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... as far as I'm concerned, as long as
　I have my Z-Chips, everything else can go
　however it likes.」

stage0095_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, in my heart, I'm rooting for all of
　you. The celebration for the ace pilots is
　on hold for next time, so be sure to come back.」

stage0095_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then! Even in the middle of the battle
　that will decide Earth and space's future,
　I'll stay fired up... business, business!」
